title: Prospectivity scouting ops cadence & field playbook
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Create an operational playbook and lightweight automation to continuously scout the model landscape, produce prioritized signals for product and procurement, and deliver a compact dashboard + alerting pipeline for go-to-market and infra decisions.

Scope:
- Define a repeatable weekly cadence for automated probes (latency, cost, API deltas) and monthly qualitative synthesis from field interviews.
- Build a signal scoring rubric (compatibility, latency delta, cost delta, switch-cost estimate, enterprise-fit) that outputs a ranked list for PM/Sales/Procurement.
- Ship a small automation pipeline (datapull -> normalization -> score -> storage) to populate a lightweight dashboard and webhook alerts.
- Create templated field-recon worksheets for Solutions/Sales to capture domain-specific failure modes.
- Run a 6-week pilot across three verticals (finserv, edtech, docs ingestion) to validate signal precision and operational burden.

Trade-offs considered: frequency vs cost of probes (token/endpoint spend), depth of behavioral probes (small synthetic suites vs full customer prompts), and degree of automation vs manual synthesis for initial runs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Weekly automated probe run executes and ingests data into dashboard with <48h freshness.
- Scoring rubric yields a top-10 ranked model list per vertical with manual review precision >= 70% (pilot).
- Field-recon template adopted by at least 2 AEs/Solution engineers in pilot and used in 6 interviews.
- Alerting rules (latency > 2x baseline OR error-rate spike > 3x) trigger Slack/webhook and a follow-up triage playbook.

Deliverables:
1) Prospectivity Scouting playbook (Confluence) with cadence, roles, templates.
2) Lightweight ETL pipeline and scoring notebook (GitHub PR).
3) Dashboard view (Console or Looker) with rank table, time-series, and alert panel.
4) Pilot report with recommendations and next-step backlog.
